# Rules

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs: do not edit. -->

mydumper-lint has 61 rules. Every rule is enabled by default unless it is opt-in; select them with `--select`, `--extend-select` and `--ignore`, or in `.mydumper-lint.yaml`.

**Suppressions**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL001](MDL001.md) | `unused-suppression` | info | safe | A suppression comment suppresses nothing. |
| [MDL002](MDL002.md) | `invalid-suppression` | warning | — | A suppression comment is malformed, names an unknown rule, or targets MDL1xx. |

**Loading: mydumper ignores the whole file**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL101](MDL101.md) | `utf8-bom` | error | safe | The file starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark. |
| [MDL102](MDL102.md) | `whitespace-only-line` | error | safe | A line contains only spaces or tabs. |
| [MDL103](MDL103.md) | `carriage-return` | error | safe | The file contains carriage returns (Windows CRLF line endings). |
| [MDL104](MDL104.md) | `missing-final-newline` | error | safe | The file does not end with a newline. |
| [MDL105](MDL105.md) | `key-before-group` | error | — | A key/value pair appears before the first [group] header. |
| [MDL106](MDL106.md) | `invalid-group-line` | error | safe | A line starting with `[` is not a valid group header. |
| [MDL107](MDL107.md) | `empty-key` | error | — | A line starts with `=`: the key is empty. |
| [MDL108](MDL108.md) | `bracket-state-leak` | error | safe | mydumper's pre-processor mis-handles a line because an earlier line contains `[`. |
| [MDL109](MDL109.md) | `unparsable-line` | error | — | GLib rejects a line for a reason no more specific rule describes. |
| [MDL110](MDL110.md) | `invalid-key-name` | error | — | A key contains `]`, or a `[` that is not a valid locale suffix. |
| [MDL111](MDL111.md) | `nul-byte` | error | — | A NUL byte makes a line unparsable. |
| [MDL112](MDL112.md) | `bracket-leak-risk` | warning | — | An empty line placed after this line would make mydumper ignore the file. |
| [MDL113](MDL113.md) | `unsupported-flag-without-value` | error | safe | A line without `=` in a mydumper version that has no pre-processor. |

**Groups**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL201](MDL201.md) | `unknown-group` | warning | — | A group that neither mydumper, myloader nor the MySQL client library reads. |
| [MDL202](MDL202.md) | `group-name-case` | error | unsafe | A group name matches a known group only when case is ignored. |
| [MDL203](MDL203.md) | `group-name-whitespace` | error | unsafe | A group name starts or ends with spaces. |
| [MDL204](MDL204.md) | `malformed-table-group` | error | unsafe | A group looks like a table section but is not written ``[`db`.`table`]``. |
| [MDL205](MDL205.md) | `duplicate-group` | warning | unsafe | The same group is declared twice. |

**Lines, keys and values**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL301](MDL301.md) | `duplicate-key` | warning | unsafe | The same key appears twice in a group. |
| [MDL302](MDL302.md) | `trailing-whitespace-in-value` | error | unsafe | A value ends with spaces or tabs, which GLib keeps. |
| [MDL303](MDL303.md) | `inline-comment` | warning | unsafe | A `#` comment after a value is part of the value. |
| [MDL304](MDL304.md) | `semicolon-comment` | error | safe | A line starting with `;` is a key, not a comment. |
| [MDL305](MDL305.md) | `localized-key` | warning | — | A key with a `[locale]` suffix depends on the runtime language. |
| [MDL306](MDL306.md) | `leading-whitespace` | info | safe | A key, comment or group header is indented. |
| [MDL307](MDL307.md) | `spaces-around-equals` | info | safe | Spaces around `=`. |
| [MDL308](MDL308.md) | `flag-without-value` | info | safe | An option written without `=`, such as `routines`. |
| [MDL309](MDL309.md) | `trailing-whitespace` | warning | safe | A comment or group header ends with spaces or tabs. |
| [MDL310](MDL310.md) | `blank-lines` | info | safe | Several consecutive empty lines, or empty lines at the end of the file. |
| [MDL311](MDL311.md) | `invalid-utf8` | warning | — | A line contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8. |
| [MDL312](MDL312.md) | `control-character` | warning | — | A line contains an invisible control character. |
| [MDL313](MDL313.md) | `quoted-value` | warning | unsafe | An option's value is wrapped in quotes, which mydumper keeps. |

**Options**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL401](MDL401.md) | `unknown-option` | error | unsafe | A key of [mydumper] or [myloader] is not an option of the target version. |
| [MDL402](MDL402.md) | `boolean-flag-value` | error | unsafe | An option that takes no value is given one that looks like `false`. |
| [MDL403](MDL403.md) | `invalid-number` | error | — | A numeric option's value is not a number GLib accepts. |
| [MDL404](MDL404.md) | `empty-option-value` | warning | — | An option that expects a value is given an empty one. |
| [MDL405](MDL405.md) | `plaintext-password` | warning | — | The file holds a password in plain text. |
| [MDL406](MDL406.md) | `invalid-regex` | warning | — | A regular-expression option's value does not compile. |
| [MDL407](MDL407.md) | `octal-integer` | warning | — | An integer written with a leading 0 is read in octal. |
| [MDL408](MDL408.md) | `value-parsed-as-option` | error | — | A value starting with `-` is parsed as an option. |
| [MDL409](MDL409.md) | `non-ascii-option-value` | warning | — | A string option's value contains non-ASCII characters. |

**Table sections and masking**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL501](MDL501.md) | `unknown-table-key` | error | unsafe | A key of a table section that mydumper does not know. |
| [MDL502](MDL502.md) | `unknown-masquerade-function` | error | unsafe | A masked column's value names no masking function of the version. |
| [MDL503](MDL503.md) | `masquerade-function-prefix` | warning | — | A masking function is selected by a prefix of a longer word. |
| [MDL504](MDL504.md) | `masquerade-syntax` | error | — | A masking function's arguments make mydumper stop, or misbehave. |
| [MDL505](MDL505.md) | `malformed-masquerade-key` | error | unsafe | A masked column is missing its closing backtick. |
| [MDL506](MDL506.md) | `sql-unbalanced` | error | — | An SQL value has unbalanced parentheses, quotes or comments. |
| [MDL507](MDL507.md) | `columns-count-mismatch` | warning | — | `columns_on_select` and `columns_on_insert` list different numbers of columns. |
| [MDL508](MDL508.md) | `masquerade-file-missing` | warning (opt-in) | — | A `<file X>` of a masking format does not exist. |
| [MDL509](MDL509.md) | `table-group-not-dumped` | info (opt-in) | — | A table section names a table the `regex` of [mydumper] excludes. |
| [MDL510](MDL510.md) | `extra-file-section-dropped` | error | — | The defaults file is rejected, so the extra file's table sections and variable groups are ignored. |
| [MDL511](MDL511.md) | `table-sections-lost` | error | — | This mydumper version ignores every table section, masking included. |

**Connection (MySQL client library)**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL601](MDL601.md) | `connection-keys-ignored` | error | unsafe | `host`, `user` or `password` in a group where nobody reads them. |
| [MDL602](MDL602.md) | `mysql-include-directive` | warning | — | `!include` or `!includedir`: a MySQL directive that mydumper does not follow. |
| [MDL603](MDL603.md) | `client-group-overridden` | warning | — | An extra file makes the MySQL client library ignore the defaults file's [client]. |

**Team conventions**

| Rule | Name | Severity | Fix | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDL901](MDL901.md) | `filename-pattern` | error | — | The file name does not follow the naming convention. |
| [MDL902](MDL902.md) | `value-template` | error | — | A value does not match its template. |
| [MDL903](MDL903.md) | `table-schema-template` | error | — | A table section names another database than the template. |
| [MDL904](MDL904.md) | `required-key` | error | — | A key the conventions require is missing. |
| [MDL905](MDL905.md) | `forbidden-key` | error | — | A key or group the conventions forbid is present. |
